title: Unit – 1 : Session – 4 | Basic Human Aspiration — Happiness and Prosperity
sections: Q1. HAPPINESS = the state of being in harmony / in synergy — 'to be in a state of liking'. More precisely: the state in which there is no contradiction between what I am and what I really want to be. UNHAPPINESS = the state of being in contradiction, conflict, dislike. CONTINUITY of happiness means happiness that is unbroken in time — not occasional pleasure that comes and goes, but a stable state of harmony at all times; the basic aspiration is not happiness 'sometimes' but happiness in continuity.

Q2. PROSPERITY = the feeling of having/producing MORE THAN REQUIRED physical facility. It has two components: (1) correct assessment of what is required (needs are limited), and (2) the competence to produce/ensure more than that. A PROSPEROUS person knows their need, has more than enough, and thinks of sharing and nurturing others. A DEPRIVED person feels they do not have enough — irrespective of how much they actually possess — and thinks of accumulating and exploiting. Deprivation is thus a feeling, not merely a material condition.

Q3. Without clarity about the basic aspiration (continuous happiness & prosperity), all our efforts shoot at wrong or partial targets — money, marks, position — and even on achieving them we remain unfulfilled, so effort multiplies without satisfaction. Clarity aligns every step with the real goal. OUR PROGRAM: (1) Understand the harmony — right understanding in the Self, and (2) Live in harmony — at all four levels (Self, family, society, nature), ensuring right feeling and physical facility in the right priority.
